doc: The first-match tutorial (scripts/match/tutorial.gd), short (owner, Nov 8): ten steps, one banner line each. steps: [id, the line]. %W swing or shoot, %J jump, %G glide, %E the E key, %T the Boki key, %s the Boki's name, %A an ability's name; the step's key shows as a key cap beside the line. alt: the line for part of a step (steering the drop before the walk, the gap step after two falls, the Boki starting out). labels: the marker's caption per course stop or step. mob: how the tutorial's monsters differ from real ones (a little tougher and bigger, damage and attack tempo down; the first one dies to one magazine). cds: the share of its usual time every ability and dash cooldown takes here (0.25 = four times quicker); each is also ready again when a step starts, is retried or its action lands. need: how many times a step's action must land (shoot: monsters beaten, sig: casts), shown as 1/3 on the pill when more than one. rival: beats 7 and 8 (TutorialRival): the rival Hunter's name, how far off it lands (dist_m), its health share (hp; late_hp after late_s of fighting), its damage share (dmg), the slow-motion and camera nudge on its knock (slow_s, slow_k, shake), how far the loose Boki wisp floats from the Hunter Wisp (apart_m), the reach of the 'that's the Hunter' toast (warn_m) and of the grab (grab_m), the hold that grabs (hold_s), seconds until the downed rival is gone after the grab (gone_s), and the labels and lines. The moves and rules the cut steps taught are one-time hints now (content/rules/hints.json).
steps: Tap %T to send %s at the monster
Round is a Hunter, critter a Boki
Hold %F at the chest to open it
Step into the light to go home

alt.gap_help: Just jump and hold %G. The wind carries you.
alt.throw_send: Tap %T again to send %s at the monster

pell_doc: Pell, the guide (TutorialGuide): one short line when it stops you at the start of a step (the same %keys as the steps; the box closes itself after a few seconds), and the portrait mood for steps that are not neutral.

dash: A gap! Run off the glowing pad and dash.
sig: A whole group: that's what %A is for.
throw: That one spits from afar. Send %s at it!
fight: More of them! Beat them all, you and %s.
chest: Here's a chest key. Open that chest!
extract: The lift is open. Step into the light!
rival: Other Hunters carry Boki lights too. Knock that one down!
grab: You can't take a Hunter. You can take a Boki. Hold %F on the critter light.

rival.name: Rival
rival.hunter_toast: That's the Hunter. Try the little critter.
rival.grab_toast: You carry a stolen Boki. It goes home when the match ends, and you keep its echo.
